Position Overview: The Senior Director of Engineering is a critical leader, responsible for defining and executing the global engineering strategy across medical device manufacturing operations. This role will lead cross-functional engineering teams, drive technological innovation, enhance manufacturing capabilities, and elevate operational performance across all sites. The Senior Director will partner closely with executive leadership to align engineering initiatives with corporate goals, ensuring scalability, compliance, and competitive advantage.

What You Will Do

Provide strategic vision and executive leadership for global engineering and advanced manufacturing functions.

Architect and implement long-term engineering roadmaps aligned with business growth and innovation strategies.

Lead large-scale process optimization, automation, and cost-reduction initiatives across multiple manufacturing sites.

Champion the adoption of advanced technologies, smart manufacturing, and digital transformation.

Develop and standardize world-class manufacturing processes that drive quality, consistency, and efficiency.

Build and lead high-performing, multidisciplinary engineering teams focused on continuous improvement and innovation.

Collaborate with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations to ensure engineering excellence from concept to commercialization.

Establish and report on key engineering performance metrics tied to product quality, time-to-market, and operational efficiency.

Ensure engineering programs comply with FDA, ISO, and other global regulatory standards.

Influence capital investments and infrastructure decisions to support long-term manufacturing strategy.

Serve as a technical advisor to senior executives and contribute to strategic planning and organizational development.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Leads a multi-site team of engineers and technical professionals.

Responsible for departmental structure, hiring, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development.

Oversees the execution and prioritization of complex engineering projects and continuous improvement programs.

Provides coaching, mentorship, and professional development opportunities to emerging leaders within the engineering function.

Skills For Success

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a closely related technical field.

Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in advanced manufacturing or engineering leadership roles.

8+ years of experience in senior-level engineering management with multi-site or global oversight.

Medical Device Industry Experience Strongly Preferred.

Preferred Education And Experience:

Master’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration (MBA), or related field.

Certified Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent lean manufacturing certifications.

Experience integrating new technologies (e.g., automation, robotics, digital manufacturing).

>40% travel required. Person ideally should be seated near Plano, Texas. This role will be instrumental in driving Global engineering strategy, Manufacturing innovation and automation, Process optimization and operational excellence, Digital transformation initiatives & high-performing, multi-site engineering teams.

jobs.description:
About SaniSure

SaniSure is a high-growth multinational manufacturer of single-use products and systems used in the production of biological drugs, including cell therapies, gene therapies, and vaccines. With operations in the U.S. and Europe, we supply global pharmaceutical and biotech companies with the critical tools they need to develop and manufacture some of today's most innovative and life-changing medicines.

As we continue to expand our product offerings and global footprint, SaniSure offers an exciting opportunity to join a nimble, customer-focused company at the forefront of the biotech industry.

Job Summary

The Director of Engineering – Design is responsible for global product design at SaniSure. Scope includes assuring velocity and efficiency of drawing and Bill of Material throughput while maintaining accuracy and quality, tracking and managing associated key performance indicators (KPIs), selecting and deploying software, training, design tools, and design libraries, authoring and updating design SOPs and Work Instructions, engineering data integrity and data services, and the Engineering portions of product change control and change management, and urgently resolving design-related issues that impact production and end-customers.

Essential Functions

Manage the global team responsible for computer-aided design (CAD) at SaniSure. Set and continuously improve global CAD standards, templates, design libraries, and assure deployment and training.
Provide global leadership for deployment of 3D CAD and PDM. Work cross-functionally to build out the global data systems framework.
Develop deep product knowledge to provide technical design expertise to Sales, Customers, and other functional areas. Consult with other subject matter experts as required.
Review design requirements inputs from Customers, Sales, and Product Line Managers. Assure requirements are clearly translated into design features. Push for clarity and for closure of gaps in information.
Serve as the main point of Design contact for major customer Requests for Proposals (RFPs).
Analyze mechanical designs, including sketches, technical drawings, schematics, specifications and associated product measurements. Conduct risk assessments using FMEA framework, and drive risk mitigations as required. Lead design and drawing reviews as needed.
Promote the options for presenting alternative designs to customers, especially when it comes to products manufactured by SaniSure.
Assist engineering personnel with material sourcing for new parts in support of their designs.
Obtain and assemble data, including product data sheets and material quotes, to complete drawings and bills of materials (BOMs).
Ensure full technical documentation of designs including BOMs, drawings, schematics, engineering change control, and procedures adhere to customer requirements, industry regulations, and quality standards.
Assure efficient prioritization and task management. Directly engage in ongoing oversight of turn-around-times for drawings and BOMs. Drive the global team to meet or exceed their objectives for established metrics and Targets To Improve (TTIs), especially time commitments, while maintaining accuracy.
Work with R&D, New Product Introduction, and with Manufacturing to integrate a Design for Manufacture & Assembly (DFMA) and Design to Cost (DTC) perspective.
Maintain organized and controlled records of all drawings and BOMs. Drive and facilitate assigned portions of product change management and control.
Own data integrity and data services when it comes to item master creation and curating assigned product data within SaniSure databases. This includes Product Data Management (PDM) and ERP.
Support product configuration management.
Develop and maintain positive rapport and working relationships with other personnel across the organization in support of initiatives to execute product improvements and enhancements.
Provide technical direction and guidance to less experienced Engineers and Drafters.
Provide inputs for departmental budgeting, and track and manage to assure spending stays within set parameters.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering; Master's preferred.

Required Experience & Competencies

Minimum 10 years of overall Engineering experience.
Minimum 5 years in a former role managing a team of Engineers.
Experience with staffing, and with growing and developing strong teams. This includes active performance management.
Experience setting top-down department goals and objectives tied to business metrics and driving team performance in the context of business results.
Expert knowledge and demonstrated hands-on experience with Solidworks CAD software, both 3D and 2D.
Knowledge of plastic component and tool design, especially injection molding, and some blow molding.
Able to read and comprehend and interpret documents such as drawings, BOMs, blueprints, and operating procedures. Able to train and guide less experienced personnel on proper interpretation and best practices.
Advanced understanding of mathematical fundamentals of plane and solid geometry, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
Design control, change control, risk management experience (FMEA).
In depth knowledge of creation of 2D and 3D drawings and related Bill of Materials (BoMs).
Able to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Strong MS Office skills, including Excel.
Strong ERP knowledge, SyteLine preferred.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Patient, tactful, diplomatic, and approachable.
Able to represent SaniSure from a position of design expertise when customer-facing.
Able to stay calm in challenging situations.
Keen sense of urgency and ability to deliver ahead of deadlines.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Able to establish and maintain effective working relationships.
Able to effectively work in a fast-paced environment and frequently manage multiple priorities.
Must be self-motivated, amendable to a variety of work projects and work efficiently independently and as part of a team.
Excellent follow-up skills.
Preferred experience: Single Use Consumable design and development experience, experience working with multiple bioprocessing equipment suppliers.

Principles That Guide Us

Focus on the mission: We view software as a means of effecting change in the world, not as an end unto itself. We write software to empower our patients and therapist to better solve the problems they're facing.

jobs.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About The Role

Suno is hiring two Senior Engineering Managers to help lead our Product Engineering organization as we build the applications that unlock creative fulfillment for over 100 million creators. Each Senior EM will own a pillar of the product, manage a group of Engineering Managers, and partner closely with product, design, and data science to set direction and ship experiences people love. These are hands-on leadership roles for people who want to shape both the technical roadmap and the managers who execute it, in a fast-paced, music-obsessed environment.

You'll bring together a group of engineering teams under a shared roadmap, set the technical bar across that group, and grow the managers and engineers who report to you. You'll work closely with the other Senior Engineering Managers and with senior product, design, and data science partners to make sure your teams' work connects to Suno's broader strategy.

Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/c3oBVSyd2ywwKIcc

What You'll Do

Own the technical direction across your pillar, setting architecture strategy and ensuring scalable, high-quality systems that serve millions of creators
Manage and coach a group of Engineering Managers — setting a hiring bar, running effective performance cycles, and building a culture where teams do their best work
Partner with senior product, design, and data science leaders to define multi-team roadmaps, sequence bets, and ship features that move the needle
Navigate the full development lifecycle from ideation through launch across multiple teams simultaneously, managing tradeoffs and removing blockers at the organizational level
Champion engineering craft across your pillar — code quality, robust testing, and the right balance of rapid iteration with long-term maintainability
Represent your pillar in cross-functional planning and leadership discussions, connecting day-to-day execution to Suno's broader strategy
Contribute to Suno's mission of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone by delivering the tools and platform that turn imagination into music

What You'll Need

Must-Haves

7+ years managing software engineering teams in a direct-to-consumer product organization, including experience managing other engineering managers, with a track record of shipping impactful consumer products at scale
Strong technical foundation — you can review code, guide architectural decisions across multiple teams, and jump into the codebase when needed
Experience setting multi-team roadmaps and translating ambiguous, org-level problems into clear plans and shipped features alongside senior product, design, and data science partners
A demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain strong engineering managers and engineers — you care deeply about growing people's careers
Hands-on experience building and operating systems at scale in a production environment
Comfort thriving in fast-paced, ambiguous environments while keeping multiple teams focused across competing priorities
Forward-looking perspective on integrating AI and agentic coding into production engineering workflows
A love of music (listening, exploring, making — we're not picky about genre)

Nice-to-Haves

Experience at a consumer tech or creator-platform company
Time spent at both larger organizations and smaller, high-growth startups
Familiarity with AI/ML-powered product development
Working knowledge of Modern web and native mobile technologies,, consumer media systems, or real-time systems

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S.
These are in-person roles based in Suno's New York City or Los Angeles office — please indicate your location preference when applying

Company Equity Package
401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)
Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)
11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time
16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave
Creative Education Stipend
Generous Commuter Allowance
In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)
